newsitem.title: CHINA: HK's Arrowtown Assets loan raised to HK$7.0 bln.
newsitem.headline: HK's Arrowtown Assets loan raised to HK$7.0 bln.

text.p: The term loan facility for Arrowtown Assets Ltd has been increased to HK$7.0 billion from HK$6.5 billion due to oversubscription, arranger Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi's Hong Kong branch said.
The deal is guaranteed by Sun Hung Kai Properties and Swire Properties, a unit of Swire Pacific.
Proceeds will be used to finance the redevelopment of the former Shiu Wing steel mill site into residential space in Hong Kong's Tseung Kwan O district.
The four-year loan pays a margin of 50 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 58 basis points.

Arrangers are Chase Manhattan Asia, Hang Seng Bank, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, Banque Nationale de Paris's Hong Kong branch, Sanwa Bank's Hong Kong branch, Standard Chartered Bank, Sakura Bank, Sumitomo Bank, Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank's Hongkong branch, Dresdner Bank, Fuji Bank and National Australia Bank.
Co-arrangers are Mitsubishi Trust and Banking Corp's Hong Kong branch, Tokai Bank's Hong Kong branch, ABN AMRO Bank, Toyo Trust and Banking Co's Hong Kong branch.
Lead managers are Daiwa Bank's Hong Kong branch and Hamburgische Landesbank's Hongkong branch.
Co-lead managers are CARIPLO's Hong Kong branch, Commerz (East Asia) and Westdeutsche Landesbank.
